newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-JUVENTUS PLANS STOCK MARKET LISTING - PRESS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS PLANS STOCK MARKET LISTING - PRESS.

text.p: Italian football league leaders and European Cup holders Juventus will seek a stock exchange listing soon and Fiat's stake in the Turin club will be taken over by the Agnelli family holding company IFI, weekly news magazine Panorama said on Thursday.

In an extract of an article to appear in Friday's edition, Panorama said "it is probable that Juventus will choose a foreign stock market for its debut", adding that the most likely coordinator of the operation was Salomon Brothers.
Panorama said IFI would acquire from Fiat the 42 percent stake it does not own by June, taking full control of the club.
Another Serie A club, AC Milan, has also been reported to be considering a stock market float. The club is owned by billionaire media mogul and opposition Freedom Alliance leader Silvio Berlusconi.
